description:
The new food pyramid was built by corporate interests.

General Mills, Danone, the beef industry, and more had financial ties to the scientists writing the new dietary guidelines.

RFK said he couldn't be bought, then he let Big Food write the nutrition guidelines.

description:
Your boss could be stealing tens of thousands of dollars straight out of your paycheck.

Every year, an estimated 10-30% of employers rig the system by misclassifying their workers as independent contractors to evade paying minimum wage, overtime, and benefits. Minnie and Marco explain how it works.

Video by @seizethemeansstreet
title: Your Boss is Stealing From You

author: More Perfect Union
description:
The Trump administration is betraying every MAHA idea, and AOC just caught the director of the EPA red handed colluding with a company poisoning America.

EPA administrator Lee Zeldin colluded with Bayer-Monsanto, which is doing everything it can to keep selling Roundup across America, even though its key ingredient is a dangerous, cancer-causing chemical.
title: The EPA director is colluding with a cancer-causing chemical company
